message: Yeah, one can only push these things so far. I would point out, however, that *enabling* isn't quite the same as *permitting*, so there's a little slippage in that reduction there. On the other hand, many of us are familiar with the lamentation that students think all useful knowledge is available via the Web, which has a bit of truth to it for some students, but also strikes me as rather contemptuous. I really didn't learn how to do library research well until I was a graduate student; up to that point, it simply escaped me that all these esoteric journals *existed*: I think we know what impinges upon our daily lives, and students have had contact with the Web, and haven't had contact with indices and databases.
